rows.variable template, inline constexpr:
template <class T> inline constexpr char tag = 0;
static_assert(&tag<int> != &tag<long>);
rows.variable template, constexpr:
template <class T> constexpr char tag = 0;
static_assert(&tag<int> != &tag<long>);
rows.static member of class template:
template <class T> struct K { static constexpr char tag = 0; };
static_assert(&K<int>::tag != &K<long>::tag);
rows.two inline constexpr variables:
inline constexpr char a = 0; inline constexpr char b = 0;
static_assert(&a != &b);
rows.two constexpr variables:
constexpr char a = 0; constexpr char b = 0;
static_assert(&a != &b);
rows.two static locals of an inline function:
inline const char* f() { static const char x = 0; return &x; }
constexpr char z = 0; static_assert(&z != nullptr);
